name: Methocarbamol / Paracetamol 400/350mg 30 Tablets
description: The combination of methocarbamol and paracetamol is a common treatment for pain associated with muscle spasms. It is generally considered safe when used under medical supervision and at the appropriate dosage. Uses of the Combination This combination is indicated for: Musculoskeletal pain: Relieves painful muscle spasms, such as backache, injuries, sprains, and strains. Pain and stiffness: Helps reduce muscle stiffness and discomfort in various musculoskeletal conditions. Postoperative: Can be used for muscle pain after surgery. If discomfort persists, consult your doctor.
